entries.answer:
Igen — ezt jóval feszesebbre lehet húzni. Itt egy rövidebb, erősebb verzió:

```text
I want to translate one or more complete Python source files into equivalent, fully functional, self-contained Zig files so that each input file becomes a complete, runnable Zig file with no missing logic, no placeholders, no comments, and no extra text.

Rules:
- Output only Zig code.
- Return one complete Zig file for each input Python file.
- Translate every line and preserve full functionality.
- Do not omit, simplify, mock, simulate, summarize, or stub any part.
- Do not include comments, filenames, explanations, notes, wrappers, or formatting outside the code.
- Every output file must be standalone, complete, and runnable with no external dependencies.
```

Ha még agresszívebbre akarod tömöríteni, ez még tisztább:

```text
Translate one or more complete Python source files into equivalent, fully functional, standalone Zig files.

Requirements:
- Output only Zig code.
- Return one complete Zig file per input Python file.
- Translate every line and preserve all behavior.
- Do not skip, simplify, stub, mock, or leave anything incomplete.
- Do not include comments, filenames, explanations, placeholders, or any non-code text.
- Every Zig file must be complete, self-contained, and runnable with no external dependencies.
```
